title: Hormone Transition
text: Early pregnancy relies on the corpus luteum for progesterone. By about week 10-12, the placenta is mature enough to produce its own hormones and takes over this role.

title: Key Pregnancy Hormones
text: Progesterone: maintains the thick uterine lining and prevents uterine contractions. Oestrogen: promotes growth of the uterus and prepares breasts for lactation. Both are essential for a healthy pregnancy.
